games.name: The Intruder
games.desc:
You are alone in your house. Suddenly, the phone rings. The police department issues a warning that a criminal is on the loose. Unfortunately, the criminal has a new target: YOU. Check the cameras in your room to watch his every move. He can sometimes enter your room to look for you. Hide in the closet if he does and turn off the lights. Wait until the phone regains service.

Updates: Fixed lever bug in hospital chapter.

Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: B]
Skill-Checks: [PC: E, Gamepad: A] 
Objective: [PC: Q] 

Inspirations: The Mandela Catalogue and Five Nights at Freddy's (also a few other games)

🔺WARNING🔺: This game includes flashing lights, loud sounds, and jumpscares.

Tags: horror, scary, fnaf, intruder, cameras, monster, ghost, mandela

games.name: Super Bomb Survival
games.desc:
Super Bomb Survival is a physics-based survival game where it's raining explosives from the sky! Join your friends & enemies alike in this frantic scramble to avoid explosions of all kinds! Battle, escape random events, and become a badge tycoon! 

Buy over 70 Skills & over 20 Perks at the game's Survival Shop to tailor your character to your play-style, or hang out in the arcade and goof off. You can even ragdoll at any time!

If you enjoy the game, leave a like/favorite! It helps a lot!

Logo by tanukizzy

games.name: NORTHWIND
games.desc:
NORTHWIND is a roleplay survival adventure game centered around the colonization of Quebec. This world bears an expansive, beautiful landscape with magnificent mountains, rivers, caves, and settlements for you to explore. Its resources are at your disposal for however you see fit; discover cooking, hunting, smithing, and take part in many more professions to expand your expertise. Earn pounds by completing vendor quests, hunting criminals for their bounty, trading with others, or by enlisting and rising through the ranks of the redcoat militia. How you take on the frontier is entirely up to you.





Tags: Survival, Hunting, PVP, Factions, House Building
